steps.method: First Order Conditional Estimation with Interaction (Evaluation)

control_stream_as_run: $PROBLEM ferx #3121 anchor (MAXEVAL=0 at the initial estimates): residual SD a non-affine function of IPRED, A*EXP(B*IPRED)/SQRT(NIND)
; Natural-scale naproxen arm means (data/mbma_naproxen.csv, DV*WPSE), study-level random
; effects. The within-arm SD model A*EXP(B*IPRED) divided by SQRT(NIND) is the SE of the arm
; mean; no combined / power form expresses it (d2SD/dIPRED2 != 0).
$INPUT ID ARM TIME DV TRT FLARE NIND MDV
$ESTIMATION METHOD=1 INTER MAXEVAL=0 SIGL=12 NSIG=4 FORMAT=s1PE23.16
